overview: The Medford City Council addressed several election preparations, approved municipal board appointments, and requested comprehensive legal settlement records from the administration. The council also finalized the South Street Historic District ordinance and supported a statewide ballot question on natural psychedelics.

items.title: Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved meeting records from July 23, 2024, and accepted the Planning and Permitting Committee report on a recent GIS mapping workshop with the zoning consultant.

items.title: Panda Express Special Permit Hearing
items.summary: Continued the public hearing on a petition by Panda Express for extended operating hours to September 10, 2024, because the petitioner was absent.

items.title: National Grid Grant of Location Amendment
items.summary: Tabled National Grid's petition to amend a previously approved grant of location for underground conduits on Main Street due to the applicant's absence.

items.title: Common Victualler License for Shop and Go
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license transfer for Shop and Go at 374 Salem Street under new ownership.

items.title: Executive Session on Litigation and Claims
items.summary: Voted to enter executive session to discuss strategy regarding pending litigation involving Samari Montes and Teamsters Local 25.

items.title: September 2024 State Primary Call for Election and Warrant
items.summary: Approved the official call for election and signed the warrant for the September 3, 2024 state primary, while also passing a resolution requesting citywide voter outreach regarding the election.

items.title: Rodent Infestation and Mitigation Strategy
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting meetings with city administration, neighboring municipalities, and Tufts Medicine to develop comprehensive rodent mitigation plans, accompanied by substantial public discussion.

items.title: Reporting of Legal Claims, Settlements, and Outside Counsel Costs
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting the mayor provide a comprehensive accounting of city legal settlements, insurance coverage, and outside legal expenditures from fiscal years 2021 through 2025.

items.title: Board Appointments and Reappointments
items.summary: Confirmed William O'Keefe to the Election Commission, reappointed Michael Luongo to the Medford Housing Authority, and appointed Ann Schiavone to the Medford Housing Authority as tenant representative.

items.title: Endorsement of Statewide Ballot Question 4
items.summary: Approved a resolution endorsing statewide Question 4 on the November ballot concerning the limited legalization and regulation of natural psychedelic substances.

items.title: Food Truck Permit and Personnel Ordinance Amendment
items.summary: Approved a food truck permit for the Brooks PTO Fall Festival and ordained an amendment to the personnel ordinance reclassifying the Community Social Worker role as Social Services Coordinator across all three readings.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Heard resident remarks regarding party registration rules and voter deadlines for the upcoming 35th Middlesex District state primary.

items.title: South Street Historic District and Related Ordinances
items.summary: Ordained the South Street Historic District ordinance on third reading following the announced retirement of longtime commissioner Christopher Bader, and subsequently approved paper 24-434 on third reading.
